story:
SERIES ひだまり人生劇場.
Host: Haru-san (ハルさん), the host of every episode: 75, small and slightly plump, kind eyes with smile lines, short silver hair in a neat low bun, round tortoiseshell glasses, a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white blouse, a navy apron, a beige long skirt, brown slip-on shoes. Not a kimono. As a kit doll: age elder, build round, figure adult, skin #f1d2b6, hairStyle low-bun, hairColor #c9c6c2, top cardigan, topColor #d9a63a, innerColor #f8f5ee, bottom long-skirt, bottomColor #d8c7a6, accent #2f3d5c, apronColor #2f3d5c, shoeColor #7a4f2e, accessories round-glasses and apron.
Set: 喫茶ひだまり, a small Showa-era kissaten: set kit place kissaten (built in: wooden counter, siphon coffee maker, teapots, old tube radio, round wall clock, potted plants, a large window with warm afternoon light), main #efe2c6, accent #b0773a. Its back veranda (縁側) is set kit place veranda.
Palette: warm amber / cream / muted sage, soft and nostalgic: #efe2c6 #b0773a #d9a63a #8fa58a #2f3d5c.
Rules: adult proportions for every character (the channel forbids chibi); the same host and kissaten in every episode.

【喫茶ひだまりの店内、春の午後。大きな窓から温かい日差し。】春の午後、喫茶ひだまりの窓から、やわらかな日が差しこみます。
【喫茶ひだまりの入口。古い封筒を持った老紳士が入ってくる。】カランと扉が鳴って、古い封筒を手にした、老紳士が入ってきました。
【カウンターの上の、色あせた古い封筒（インサート）。】五十年前、好きだった人に、出せなかった手紙だといいます。
【カウンター席。ハルさんが紅茶を淹れ、老紳士のとなりに座る。】ハルさんは、桜の香りの紅茶を淹れて、黙って、となりに座りました。
【カウンター席。老紳士が手紙を読み、読み終えて小さく笑う。】老紳士は、手紙を、声に出して読みはじめました。読み終えると、小さく、笑いました。
【老紳士の顔のアップ、午後の光。】「やっと、言えた気がします」。
【夕方の川沿いの道、満開の桜。花びらが封筒の上に落ちる。】帰り道、川沿いの桜が、ひとひら、封筒の上に落ちました。

bible.title: ひだまり人生劇場・春の手紙
bible.logline: 五十年越しの想いが、桜の香りと共に解き放たれる午後

cast.name: ハルさん
cast.look: Small, slightly plump elder woman with kind eyes and smile lines, short silver hair in a neat low bun, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard‑yellow knit cardigan over a white blouse, navy apron, beige long skirt, brown slip‑on shoes. Adult proportions.

cast.name: 老紳士
cast.look: Older gentleman, slightly stooped, wearing a dark navy wool coat, sage‑green trousers, amber leather shoes, holding an old yellowed envelope. Adult proportions.

cast.name: 古い封筒
cast.look: Yellowed paper envelope with frayed edges, sealed with a dark amber wax stamp. When opened the flap reveals a folded letter.

states.look: Envelope closed, wax stamp visible, corners slightly worn.
Flap lifted, folded letter visible inside, paper fibers exposed.

cast.name: 喫茶ひだまり
cast.look: Small Showa‑era kissaten interior: wooden counter, siphon coffee maker, teapots, old tube radio, round wall clock, potted plants, large window flooding the room with warm afternoon light. Cream walls with amber accents.

cast.name: 川沿いの道
cast.look: Riverside path lined with full‑bloom cherry trees, petals drifting in a gentle evening breeze, soft amber‑gold light on the water.

shots.description: The kissaten interior basks in spring afternoon light. Warm sunbeams stream through the large window onto the wooden counter, teapots, and potted plants. Cream walls glow amber. Haru-san stands behind the counter, wiping a cup.
shots.dialogue: 春の午後、喫茶ひだまりの窓から、やわらかな日が差しこみます。

shots.description: The wooden door slides open with a gentle 'karan' chime. The elderly gentleman steps inside, stooped slightly, dark navy coat catching the light. He clutches the yellowed envelope in both hands, eyes scanning the room.
shots.dialogue: カランと扉が鳴って、古い封筒を手にした、老紳士が入ってきました。

shots.description: Insert shot: the envelope rests on the wooden counter, its frayed corners and dark amber wax stamp catching the afternoon sun. Dust motes drift in the beam. The seal is intact, fifty years of silence held in paper fibers.
shots.dialogue: 五十年前、好きだった人に、出せなかった手紙だといいます。

shots.description: Over-the-shoulder from behind Haru-san as she pours cherry-blossom tea from a ceramic pot into two cups. Steam curls. She sets the pot down, turns, and sits on the stool beside the gentleman. Two-shot: both at the counter, tea between them.
shots.dialogue: ハルさんは、桜の香りの紅茶を淹れて、黙って、となりに座りました。

shots.description: The gentleman lifts the envelope, breaks the wax seal, and unfolds the letter. He reads aloud, voice low. Haru listens, hands on her cup. Light slants lower, amber deepening. He finishes, refolds, and a small smile crinkles his eyes.
shots.dialogue: 老紳士は、手紙を、声に出して読みはじめました。読み終えると、小さく、笑いました。

shots.description: Tight on the gentleman's face, afternoon light gilding his cheekbones. Eyes glisten, smile lines deepen. He whispers the line to himself, shoulders dropping a lifetime's weight.

Evening on the river path. Cherry trees in full bloom canopy the walkway, petals sailing on the breeze. The gentleman walks away from us, envelope in hand. A single petal spirals down and lands on the flap. Amber-gold water reflects blossoms.
shots.dialogue: 帰り道、川沿いの桜が、ひとひら、封筒の上に落ちました。

actionNotes.5: The envelope is not clearly visible and the lighting lacks amber depth.
